Selected Homme – Figo Full Sleeves Zip T-Shirt with Logo

Upgrade your everyday wardrobe with the Selected Homme Figo full sleeves zip T-Shirt with Logo, designed for men who value comfort, sustainability, and modern style. Crafted with precision and premium materials, this versatile T-shirt seamlessly blends performance wear functionality with casual elegance, making it ideal for daily wear, travel, gym sessions, or relaxed weekends.

The Figo full sleeves zip T-Shirt with Logo is made using a thoughtfully engineered fabric blend that balances softness, durability, and breathability. With a composition of 50% Organic Cotton & 50% Recycled Polyester, this T-shirt supports eco-conscious fashion while delivering superior comfort. The organic cotton ensures a natural, skin-friendly feel, while recycled polyester adds strength, shape retention, and long-lasting performance.

Featuring Fabric: Organic Cotton & Recycled Polyester, this garment reflects Selected Homme’s commitment to sustainability and responsible sourcing. As a certified Green Facility Product, it is manufactured with reduced environmental impact, making it a smart choice for modern consumers who care about the planet as much as they care about style.

Comfort Meets Performance

Designed with a GSM of 160, the strikes the perfect balance between durability and lightweight comfort. The dry fit & light weight construction ensures efficient moisture management, keeping you cool and fresh throughout the day. Whether worn as a standalone piece or layered under a jacket, this  adapts effortlessly to different weather conditions.

The sleek zip-neck design adds a contemporary edge, while the subtle logo detailing enhances brand appeal without overpowering the minimalist aesthetic. The tailored fit flatters the silhouette, making it suitable for both casual and semi-active lifestyles.

  • Fabric: Organic Cotton & Recycled Polyester

  • Eco Feature: Green Facility Product
  • Available Colors: Navy Blue

Why Choose?

The is perfect for men looking for premium quality men’s apparel that aligns with modern sustainability standards. Its breathable fabric makes it ideal for year-round wear, while the dry-fit technology ensures comfort during extended use. The Navy Blue color adds a timeless appeal, easily pairing with jeans, joggers, or chinos for a polished look.

This also performs exceptionally well as an athleisure essential. Whether you’re heading to the gym, traveling, or enjoying a casual outing, it offers flexibility, style, and durability in one refined package.

Care Instructions

To maintain the fabric quality and color vibrancy, machine wash cold with similar colors. Avoid bleach and tumble dry on low heat. Proper care ensures the longevity of the organic cotton and recycled polyester blend. Choose the to experience premium craftsmanship, eco-friendly innovation, and effortless style—all in one essential wardrobe staple.
